headline: Govt extends deadline for vehicle paper renewal without fine to Oct 29
summary: Vehicle fitness, tax tokens, route permits, and driving licenses can now be updated without penalties until October 29.
details: The Bangladesh government has extended the deadline for renewing motor vehicle documents and driving licenses without paying any fines.
According to a notification issued by the Road Transport and Highways Division of the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges, the new deadline is October 29 of this year.
Vehicle owners can now update their fitness certificates, tax tokens, and route permits, as well as renew their driving licenses, by paying only the original tax and fees.
The notification states that this extension, granted with the consent of the Finance Division, is the final extension for these renewals.
This decision provides a fresh opportunity for individuals and organizations who were unable to renew their vehicle documents within the previous deadlines.
caption:
Missed your vehicle paper renewal? You can now update them without any fines until October 29.

The Bangladesh government has extended the deadline for renewing motor vehicle documents and driving licenses without paying any fines.

According to a notification issued by the Road Transport and Highways Division of the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges, the new deadline is October 29 of this year.

Vehicle owners can now update their fitness certificates, tax tokens, and route permits, as well as renew their driving licenses, by paying only the original tax and fees.

The notification states that this extension, granted with the consent of the Finance Division, is the final extension for these renewals.

This decision provides a fresh opportunity for individuals and organizations who were unable to renew their vehicle documents within the previous deadlines.

Source: Prothom Alo

headline: Fuel crisis: Hours in line, barely enough gas for one trip
summary: Drivers are facing severe shortages as they spend hours waiting in queues for minimal fuel supplies.
details: Drivers are spending hours waiting in long queues at fuel stations to secure enough gas for their vehicles.
The shortage has left many struggling to find enough fuel for even a single trip, severely impacting their daily earnings.
This crisis is causing significant disruptions to transportation and affecting the mobility of commuters across the city.
The situation highlights a growing instability in fuel availability and the resulting hardship for transport workers.
